The Ontic Platform is a cloud-based SaaS Protective Intelligence solution that empowers federal security teams to protect high-value assets and personnel. By integrating public data, security systems, social media, dark web intelligence, geospatial risk mapping, and customizable threat assessments, Ontic delivers a unified view of potential threats. Teams can rapidly identify, assess, and investigate emerging risks with real-time alerts and continuous monitoring, enabling proactive protection and streamlined case management. With Ontic, federal agencies strengthen their security posture and respond to threats with greater speed and precision.

Learn more at ontic.co/government
